WHEREAS THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY A BUDGET PROPOSAL FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2026, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2027, AND

WHEREAS THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS MADE A COMPREHENSIVE STUDY AND REVIEW OF THE PROPOSED BUDGET AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IT IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROVE THE BUDGET AS PROPOSED.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2026, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2027.

Vint, FV James Nix, Mayor

Attest:

Amy Lomax, Town Clerk

Date: 6/2/2026
